messages.subject: Re: Error running ENMevaluate
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

It could be that there is a NA in one of your predictors based on a recent commit in ENMeval GitHub account (link <https://github.com/bobmuscarella/ENMeval/commit/325e686b6f72413a443e9c8291e63867bd9ebd13>). Wallace is removing internally NA, but it looks that this is not being done in the RMD script. One solution is checking for NA and removed then in your R script. Another solution is installing the ENMeval version on GitHub that already fixed the problem of NAs and the user method for ENMevaluate().

Please, let me know if one of these solutions works for you or if you need help installing ENMeval from GitHub.

Best,
Gonzalo
